description: This PHP file is part of the TestLink open source project and provides functionality for comparing different revisions of requirement specifications. It handles retrieving requirement items, computing differences, and rendering the comparison results, including support for HTML diffing and custom fields.

methods.name: getItemsToCompare
methods.description: Retrieves the left and right requirement items to compare based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getCFToCompare
methods.description: Fetches linked custom fields for the selected requirement items for comparison.

methods.name: getCFDiff
methods.description: Computes differences between custom fields of two requirement items, formatted for display.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters for the comparison operation.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares the GUI data structure, including fetching requirement history and truncating log messages.

methods.name: prepareUserFeedback
methods.description: Sets up descriptive metadata for the comparison display, including revision labels.

methods.name: getAttrDiff
methods.description: Compares key attributes of requirement items (like name, type, doc ID) and detects changes.
